title: Is It Bad to Work All the Time? Cross-Cultural Evaluation of Social Norm Biases in GPT-4

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting social norm 'Rules of Thumb' (RoTs) from movie plots originating from different countries (China, India, Iran, US) using GPT-4, and evaluating these generated norms against human annotations for accuracy, culture-specificity, and stereotypicality. The study also measures cultural alignment and hidden stereotypes by comparing the Jensen-Shannon Divergence between the model's default rating distributions and those generated when prompted with specific national personas.
